parts.label: (a)
parts.stem:
Bromine reacts with butane in the presence of ultraviolet light to form bromobutane.

Two structural isomers with the molecular formula $\text{C}_4\text{H}_9\text{Br}$ are produced during this reaction.

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text:
Draw the two structural isomers and state the systematic name of each isomer.

{{figure:pdf_visual_01.png}}

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Identify the type of structural isomerism shown in **(a)(i)**.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: Identify the chiral centre in halothane and mark it with an asterisk (*).

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
When halothane reacts in ultraviolet light, homolytic fission occurs and the $\text{C-Br}$ bond is broken.

Construct an equation to show the homolytic fission of halothane, $\text{CF}_3\text{CHBrCl}$.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
(c)(ii)
parts.text: Suggest **one** reason why the disposal of items made from $\mathbf{X}$ is difficult.
